name: Vendor Village Yuma Palms

Operating from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM, this community-oriented venue offers a social shopping experience that has become a popular gathering spot for local residents.
demographics: Vendor Village Yuma Palms attracts a diverse, community-oriented demographic in Yuma, Arizona, with visitors primarily consisting of local families and young adults seeking unique shopping experiences. description: Vendor Village Yuma Palms is a unique evening marketplace located in Yuma, Arizona, offering a distinctive shopping experience that brings together local vendors and community members. Operating under the evening hours from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM, this vendor village creates an after-dark market atmosphere that sets it apart from traditional shopping centers in the area. The center has cultivated a strong social media presence through its Instagram account @palms_after_dark_market, where it connects with the local community and promotes its various vendors and events. Located at 1400 Block Parkway in Yuma, the marketplace provides a casual, open-air environment where shoppers can browse offerings from multiple small businesses and independent vendors. This community-focused shopping destination has become a popular evening gathering spot for Yuma residents seeking a more personalized and social retail experience that supports local entrepreneurship.
